stages.script: function handleRequest() { var urlValues = context.envs.urlValues; if (urlValues == undefined) urlValues = {}; if (urlValues.ml__mode == undefined) { urlValues.ml__mode = 'search'; } return { envs: { ...context.envs, urlValues: urlValues } } }

function handleRequest() { const queryPassed = JSON.parse(context.request.body); const queryBuilt = {}; for (var i = 0; i < queryPassed.query.length;i++) { var query = queryPassed.query[i]; if (query.execute != undefined && !query.execute) continue; if (query.id == undefined) { throw Error(`query.id required at index: ${i}`); } var dataField = query.dataField; var queryValue = query.value; if (queryValue == undefined) { queryValue = '*'; } if (dataField == undefined) { dataField = ['description', 'label']; } else if (typeof(dataField) == 'string') { dataField = [dataField]; } var limitToUse = 10; if (query.size != undefined) { limitToUse = query.size } const filterQueryArr = []; dataField.forEach(df => { filterQueryArr.push(`CONTAINS(?${df},"${queryValue}")`) }); const filterQuery = filterQueryArr.join(' || '); queryBuilt[query.id] = { body: getSparQLQuery(filterQuery, limitToUse), headers: { 'content-type': 'application/sparql-query' }, url: '/v1/graphs/sparql', method: 'POST' }; } return { request: { body: JSON.stringify(queryBuilt) } } } function getSparQLQuery(filterQuery, limit) { const rawQuery = `SELECT DISTINCT (?label AS ?Disease) (?s AS ?Class)(?description AS ?Description) (?parentLabel AS ?Parent) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?childLabel;SEPARATOR=', ') AS ?Children) WHERE { ?s ?p ?o . ?s <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label . OPTIONAL { ?s <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115> ?description } . OPTIONAL { ?s <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf> ?parent . ?parent <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?parentLabel . FILTER ( LANG(?parentLabel) = 'en' ) } . OPTIONAL { ?child <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf> ?s . ?child <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?childLabel . FILTER ( LANG(?childLabel) = 'en' ) } . FILTER ( LANG(?label) = 'en' ) . FILTER ( ${filterQuery} ) } GROUP BY ?label LIMIT ${limit}`; return rawQuery; }

function handleRequest() { const queryPassed = JSON.parse(context.request.body); const queryBuilt = {}; for (var i = 0; i < queryPassed.query.length; i++) { var query = queryPassed.query[i]; if (query.execute != undefined && !query.execute) continue; if (query.id == undefined) { throw Error(`query.id required at index: ${i}`); } var dataField = query.dataField; var queryValue = query.value; if (queryValue == undefined) { queryValue = '*'; } if (dataField == undefined) { dataField = [ 'LastName', 'ProviderLastName', 'serviceDescription', 'label', ]; } else if (typeof dataField == 'string') { dataField = [dataField]; } var limitToUse = 10; if (query.size != undefined) { limitToUse = query.size; } const filterQueryArr = []; dataField.forEach((df) => { filterQueryArr.push( `fn.contains(fn.lowerCase(op.col('${df}')), term)` ); }); const filterQuery = filterQueryArr.join(' || '); queryBuilt[query.id] = { body: getOpticQuery(filterQuery, limitToUse, queryValue), headers: { 'content-type': 'application/vnd.marklogic.querydsl+javascript', }, url: '/v1/rows', method: 'POST', }; } return { request: { body: JSON.stringify(queryBuilt) } }; } function getOpticQuery(filterQuery, limit, queryValue) { const rawQuery = `const term = fn.lowerCase('${queryValue}');op.fromView(null, 'Member').joinInner(op.fromView(null, 'ClaimFHIR'), op.on('memberID', 'patient')).joinInner(op.fromView(null, 'ClaimItem'), op.on('identifier', 'claimId')).joinLeftOuter(op.fromView(null, 'CMSProvider'), op.on('provider', 'ProviderNPI')).joinLeftOuter(op.fromSPARQL('SELECT DISTINCT (str(?code) AS ?Code) ?label WHERE { ?code <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label }'), op.on(op.col('diagnosisIRI'), 'Code')).select(['LastName', 'ProviderLastName', 'identifier', 'type', 'serviceDescription', 'unitPrice', 'diagnosisIRI', 'label']).where( ${filterQuery} ).whereDistinct().limit(${limit})`; return rawQuery; }

function handleRequest() { const request = JSON.parse(context.request.body); const qs = JSON.parse(context.envs['ML_QS_PARAMS']); const qsKeys = Object.keys(qs); const queryArr = []; for (var i = 0; i < qsKeys.length; i++) { const key = qsKeys[i]; const value = qs[key]; queryArr.push(`${key}=${value}`); } const queryString = 'http://localhost:8011/v1/search?' + queryArr.join('&'); const endpointToReturn = { url: queryString, method: 'POST', body: request, headers: {} }; return { response: { body: JSON.stringify(endpointToReturn) } } }
function handleRequest() { return { response: { body: context.request.body } } }
